{{Youmay|tin, the metal|the [[Target Identification Network]], the [[Tinn system]], or [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]]}}
'''Tin''' was a non-rusting metal that could be melted into a liquid form.<ref name="Selonia">''[[Assault at Selonia]]''</ref>

[[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] called [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] "tin-plated.<ref name="TCW film">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref> [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] compared its taste to [[Blood/Legends|blood]] after the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] crash-landed on [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]].<ref name="Jedi Search">''[[Jedi Search]]''</ref> [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] called [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] a pile of tin, and [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] subsequently called C-3PO "tin man".<ref name="Before the Storm">''[[Before the Storm]]''</ref>
